name: Argent Veil, Divine Lance with Grief
idea: The tanky version of the Argent Veil Divine Lance build: Grief in the main hand and Herald of Zakarum in the off-hand instead of The Grandfather, which moves into the Talisman. Grief's 40% poison rides on every Divine Lance hit and its +750 Weapon Damage adds to every hit; the shield adds block, armor and resistances.
